turns.customer: The seam tape inside my Squall rain jacket (order #1127) is peeling and it leaks at the shoulders now. I bought it in early June. What can I do?
turns.reply:
Since the Squall Rain Jacket from order #1127 was delivered back in June and has been used, standard returns and damaged-item refunds don't cover wear or damage occurring after delivery. However, manufacturing defects that show up in normal use may be covered under the 1-year warranty. 

I've escalated your warranty claim to a human support agent (Ticket ESC-53). A team member will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
